title: Group Practices
description: Manage multiple clinicians, availability, resources, and locations with ease. Add as many practitioners as you need. Admin us.are free.
content:
Coordinate clinicians, rooms, and schedules in one place

Group practices need shared calendars, clear roles, and visibility across the team. ClinicPro helps you coordinate availability, resources, and locations — and admin us.are free.

Built for multi-provider teams

  • Multi-provider scheduling with rooms and resources
  • Role-based permissions for clinicians, reception, and admins
  • Shared patient records across the whole team
  • Reporting that shows utilization and performance by provider

Scale without chaos

As you add practitioners, ClinicPro keeps workflows consistent. Everyone works from the same system, patients get a unified experience, and leadership still has clear oversight.
